display_name: PAMF 物理干预方向校正半监督单种子对照
description: 同包有界两径扰动测量实际多分支有限差分；匹配比较 beta=0 与 beta=0.5。
authorization: 2026-11-10 用户要求训练机制兼具多分支与物理感知，并授权 N607 GPU 0/1 每卡两个实验进程。

code.commit: Recorded immutable release commit in runtime.json at launch
code.environment: N607 existing project Python, FP32/TF32 off, no installs

data.contract_ref: F0 same source contract and validated target handles in private runtime context
data.physical_ids_ref: F0 target physical IDs; weak view manifest physical_ids_ref

roles.L_s: true labels; up to 64 source records per L step for echo directions
roles.U_s: hidden TX; ordinary PL threshold .95; select at most 128 U independently of acceptance, use accepted subset for relations
roles.V: 27000 source validation, no training or checkpoint selection

data.validation_ref: previous VALIDATED_ONCE; Phase2 capsule/split not applicable
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 fixed prediction only; Phase2 support/query not applicable

permissions.claim_scope: single-seed exploratory, previously exposed benchmark; no general or statistical claim

checkpoint.initialization: matched F21 scratch E20, then own 10+20; no prior candidate checkpoint
sources: same-contract F21 scratch E20; preexisting ordinary PL seven-view scores; previous PL weak scores if complete
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: pamf_physics_branch.source.checked_parent using actual F21 payload and source roles
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Actual parent contract and scratch checkpoint inspected at load; fail on mismatch
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E50; no target selection or tuning

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0/1; prior run owner must be terminal; max two total observed/pending processes per card; memory admission
execution.stop_rule: Any technical failure stops new dispatch; preserve healthy workers and all artifacts; no target-driven retry

expected_artifacts: two-row real E20 source-only finite backward smoke
two own E30 and E50 source trajectories with L/U direction exposure counts
full L_s/V raw/echo, pseudo-label proxy, branch direction, L-derived class-subspace overlap and reference-delay diagnostics; 720 L and 720 V on each of three original As scenes
all per-row practical and weak predictions frozen before truth-side scoring
same-seed paired raw/DURA/weak comparison with reused ordinary PL

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: separate CPU scorer, after all same-row predictions

rows.method: ordinary PL + physical branch direction relations beta=0.0
rows.seed_notes: Original F0 seeds; echo has fixed source RNG by global step; weak view seeds in manifest; no support.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical in three F0 populations; raw three weak scenes on combined target
rows.budget_ref: reused E20/4440; own E10+E20/6660; L64/U<=128 each use two no-grad forwards

rows.method: ordinary PL + physical branch direction relations beta=0.5
rows.seed_notes: Original F0 seeds; echo has fixed source RNG by global step; weak view seeds in manifest; no support.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical in three F0 populations; raw three weak scenes on combined target
rows.budget_ref: reused E20/4440; own E10+E20/6660; L64/U<=128 each use two no-grad forwards

notes: Exploratory beta=0.5 versus matched beta=0 primary test; no significance claim from one seed.
Post-reception finite echo is a bounded propagation proxy, not identified real transmitter or full satellite channel.
Complete candidate/baseline source diagnostics before any candidate target prediction; all fixed rows then evaluated without selection.
Expansion screen: final source V beta=0.5 no worse than ordinary PL by 0.2 pp or beta=0 by 0.1 pp; report actual anchors and nonfinite counts.
Existing branch pilot runs to its terminal state before this owner uses the same GPU reservation.
Fixed final checkpoint; target results do not select, modify or restart candidates.
